item.title: Add Application Repository
item.description: This section describes how to add an application repository to the KubeSphere platform. The application repository added here is a system repository. Prerequisites You need to have the App Store Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere App Store Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. A Helm Chart repository must be created in advance.

item.title: View App Repository List
item.description: This section describes how to view the app repository list in "App Store Management". Prerequisites You need to have the App Store Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere App Store Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with App Store Management permissions.

item.title: Edit App Repository
item.description: This section describes how to edit an app repository. Prerequisites You need to have the App Store Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere App Store Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with App Store Management permissions.

item.title: Delete App Repository
item.description: This section describes how to delete an app repository. Warning Once an app repository is deleted, users cannot install applications from it. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to have the App Store Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere App Store Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.
